items.impactZh: 关键宏观数据超预期时，点差与滑点风险通常放大，建议降低仓位并控制杠杆。
items.impactEn: When macro data surprises, spread/slippage risk often widens; consider smaller position size and tighter leverage control.

items.title: Week ahead: ISM services, Fed minutes and Canadian jobs lead the economic calendar. Be aware.
items.summary: The new trading week brings a lighter economic calendar, but there are still several events that can move currencies and yields. The main highlights are Monday’s U.S. ISM services report, Wednesday’s Federal Reserve minutes, Thursday’s ECB monetary policy accounts, and Friday’s Canadian employment and U.S. consumer sentiment reports.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 新的交易周带来了更轻松的经济日历，但仍有一些事件可以移动货币和收益率。主要亮点是周一的美国ISM服务报告、周三的美联储会议记录、周四的欧洲央行货币政策账户，以及周五的加拿大就业和美国消费者信心报告。
